<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election Commission challenges:</strong> The Supreme Court is set to hear pleas challenging the appointments of CEC Gyanesh Kumar and Election Commissioners Sukhbir Sandhu and Vivek Joshi, while also revisiting a split verdict regarding the law governing these selections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTFBBWGlVenlsZG9Lc0xMLVBzd0VONGY3MjNGOEhrUWloaUstWE9VRGMxREVjdnNsNmFUdnEwRTRLenVqWGQ1NDJDZ3lyZHYxMWkybVBsYXM1YlNVWTYzRGxwb3hFQ3c1aUpGMWp3QjlB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQQjRoU3NGSFBQWUpiUXpXMy1pWkVxT2FJcVRJNzFtcUswLXB6RlozTS1wV3JWVEYwb0Z2UW5ZWjFGQ2NmR016b29CTXExZFEtSlN5cktOSEVrOTNZZVVOMXZCbDBOZkxkWVloRzZ6TjVzNTd2N1M2YjExMzhkdExlX29Ob3RfazN3MnVMV1JDaUpoaURpQlFzVXhaN0xtYXpKdGNSWHR3?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Punjab municipal elections:</strong> The Supreme Court has set aside the results of 50 municipal wards in Punjab due to the obstruction of the nomination process and ordered fresh elections to be held within six weeks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition protests and legal action:</strong> INDIA bloc leaders continue nationwide demonstrations demanding the resignation of the CEC, leading to the detention of Rahul Gandhi and the filing of FIRs against senior Congress figures following clashes with police.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Allegations of voter data manipulation:</strong> The Congress party has alleged that the ECINet system was designed to allow the BJP headquarters to centralize the addition and deletion of voters, raising concerns over electoral integrity.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition mobilization:</strong> INDIA bloc MPs are holding high-level meetings and organizing marches to Rajghat to sustain pressure on the Election Commission, while the BJP has dismissed the protests as politically motivated.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNTWNHWk5sSFFnOUdpOUUxSlQ2eE5aWGpVNW82N05naVZrS2R6UVBSTzlQRzlOd19fQU9BVU5YX3FBcDcxZjl6Zm1Fd2g2OVFYLXhzOTdjbEZ1YjJhb2FhMHJheTBWX0Z2LUtvVXk1VndIU01hWUpCR1pyZlo2TmVObnF4NXo1NHFPdXBGd2lNVG53YjRlTVlIUDNTYWtwUQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxQeXJpWjZhWW9vVml2Q3VISGZCTnd5Vk8tTTlNNjQ0aHVkMVktOWFzRkFRdWVOMjlfSFJaNjBtcWhQVEZfcnpyakRWRlVGNURjLVNVSHhrVF81SmNXMHhLbEJ0Mkl2U2ltTjhKd2hzQ2NDa2dfWWRRcmlnNGhUbGU0TXI0Z0RrcXU2bW9NYTRQLW1tMFczaGdpMjZPMTd5U0dGT3BnNGNKS2JQOVdhaG9EZnNhbFo0Q2pfRXhJUFZTblVMWU1P?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W24</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W25</a></span></li>
